title: Parking lot items table schema and migration
description: Define the parking_lot_items table for storing project ideas that are not yet prioritized, with support for AI-generated pathways and soft archiving.
acceptanceCriteria: FK to projects.id with cascade delete
ai_pathway TEXT field for storing AI-generated steps

steps.details: Create server/src/db/schema/parkingLotItems.ts. Define parking_lot_items table: id (uuid pk), project_id (uuid notNull FK → projects cascade delete), title (varchar 500 notNull), description (text nullable), ai_pathway (text nullable — AI-generated step-by-step plan), archived_at (timestamp nullable), created_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()), updated_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()).

steps.description: Export types and update schema barrel
steps.details: Export type ParkingLotItem and type NewParkingLotItem. Add 'export * from ./parkingLotItems' to schema/index.ts.
Run 'npm run db:migrate'. Verify table exists with correct schema.

technicalNotes: archived_at is used instead of deleted_at since items are never truly deleted, just hidden
ai_pathway stores the AI response as a formatted string (markdown or plain text)
